title: Release Evidence Envelope v1
description: Portable structural authority for release evidence. Cross-field arithmetic and verdict prerequisites live in tools/validation/Test-ReleaseEvidenceEnvelope.ps1.

contract_version.description: Frozen contract identity. A change here is a deliberate revision, never an in-place edit.

task_id.description: The backlog task that produced this evidence.

gate_id.description: Gate that produced the evidence. May be empty when suite_id is populated.

suite_id.description: Suite that produced the evidence. May be empty when gate_id is populated.

profile.description: Which profile the run executed under.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 completion, with offset. Never earlier than started_at.

total_count.description: Every test the producer knew about: executed plus skipped.

executed_count.description: Tests that actually ran. A skipped test is never executed.

skipped_count.description: Tests not executed. Every one is accounted for by a skip reason.

unapproved_skip_count.description: Skips carrying no approval. GREEN is impossible while this is above zero.

skip_reasons.description: One entry per distinct reason. Counts sum to skipped_count.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character Git SHA. An abbreviation cannot identify what was certified.

evidence_paths.description: Repository-relative artifact paths. Absolute paths are not portable.

verdict.description: GREEN has prerequisites that are necessary, not sufficient.
